response.overview: You can book flights directly through Emirates by entering your departure and arrival cities +1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK], travel dates, and passenger details. You can book, manage+1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK], and look up Emirates flights directly on the official Emirates Website or through the Emirates Mobile App +1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK]. Here are the direct tools and key policies for handling your reservation. Ways to Book & Manage Trips Online Booking: Search cash fares +1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK], vacation packages+1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK], or redeem AAdvantage miles on the Emirates flight search page. Phone Reservations: Call Emirates Reservations at +1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK] (24 hours in English within the U.S. and Canada +1 855-493-1028[US] & +44 204-600-0516[UK]; service fees may apply for phone ticketing).
